title: MCP list_units Response
description: Serving-integrity contract U11/R15: `tools/mcp_server.py`'s `list_units` tool response, built by `_serialize_units`. U7/R1/R2/KTD10: the chapter/unit list for one (country, curriculum, grade) scope, built from the mapping layer's unit_code/unit_name (never from parsing syllabus_ref). has_units is false for a unit-less curriculum or an uncovered scope, in which case skill_ids carries the grade's mapped skills directly instead (orchestrator/catalog.py's UnitsResult, plan point 6: unknown scope is a result, not an error).

has_units.description: False for a unit-less curriculum (e.g. Ontario in the shipped fixture) or a scope with no mapped skills at all.

units.description: Populated only when has_units is true.

skill_ids.description: This grade's mapped skills directly; populated only when has_units is false.
